featured_reviews.name: Rupali
featured_reviews.review_text:
I completed my CCNA course from the CCNA RST Forum. Overall, the course content is good and well-structured, especially for beginners who want to build a strong foundation in networking.

The main instructor who takes the initial lectures (around the first 15 sessions) explains concepts very clearly and makes the topics easy to understand. His teaching style is engaging and effective, which creates a strong interest in the course at the beginning.

However, after the initial lectures, the main instructor seems to go on vacation and the remaining sessions are handled by another trainer. Unfortunately, the second trainer’s teaching style is not easy to adapt to, and the explanation of concepts is not as clear as the main instructor’s. This creates a gap in learning continuity and affects the overall experience of the course.

For a professional course like CCNA, consistency in teaching quality is very important. The main instructor should focus more on completing the course or ensure that the replacement trainer follows the same teaching standards and methodology.

Apart from this issue, the course material is useful, and the forum provides a good learning environment. With better instructor continuity and planning, this course can become much better and more effective for students.
